Display pending messages.

## Synopsis

```text
messages
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Prints the queued Director and job messages of this console.

## Examples

Fetch job reports and mount requests queued for this console:

```text
messages
```
